critical_code_review_comments: extended_routes.py upload_athm_file (l.352–419): stores file bytes as base64 in athm_files.b64. Fine for MVP at 25 MB cap, but a 25 MB file becomes ~33 MB BSON; Mongo doc limit is 16 MB. Files over ~12 MB will fail at insert_one with BSONObjectTooLarge, not at the 413 boundary. Recommend either (a) lowering hard limit to ~11 MB until binary storage is in Supabase, or (b) chunking via GridFS. Backend test only validated boundaries (small PDF + 26 MB) so this slipped through.
extended_routes.py upload_athm_file 'max 20 files' check (l.371–373) returns 400 instead of a clearer code; copy is fine but a 409 Conflict would be more idiomatic.

ParticipantContactsPanel.jsx KIND_ORDER includes 'provider_coordinator' rather than the spec's plural 'Providers' label group. KIND_LABEL maps it to 'Provider' singular which is correct, but the panel does not render an explicit 'Providers' heading group separate from 'Provider Coordinator'. Spec asked for 'Providers' as a section label — current label says 'Provider' (KIND_PLURAL likely supplies plural). Worth double-checking the rendered heading matches 'Providers'.

Contact panel did not appear on /app/participants — the only entry point is dashboard-care-circle-cta on the caregiver dashboard. Consider adding the same opener on the per-participant view (e.g., participant detail page) so the rolodex is discoverable when navigating from the Participants list.
